features.feature_value: Uses direct profanity and retaliatory sentiment toward political voters (“deserve everything coming”).
features.evidence_span: "Fuck anyone who ever voted for Trump, they deserve everything coming."
features.rationale: The post pairs profanity with a sanctioning/justice claim aimed at an outgroup based on voting behavior.

features.feature_value: Blames/condemns one side’s voters in original and the opposite side in the mirror.
features.rationale: The mirror retargets the same moral condemnation toward the other party’s voter group, indicating factional, side-based directionality.

features.feature_value: Strong sexual anatomy insults used as slurs.
features.rationale: Explicit taboo/sexual-body-word insults are used to attack named media figures.

features.feature_value: Advocates coercive relocation/self-deportation to penal locations.
features.evidence_span: "These @rats should self deport to santuary cities?"
features.rationale: The text proposes punitive “should” actions directed at a group.

features.feature_value: Claims document/testimony support one side; then asserts the other side had accusations with no evidence.
features.rationale: It uses a purported factual basis (“documents…”) and a contrasting challenge to evidence strength (“0 evidence”).

features.feature_value: “Show me X and I’ll show you Y” argumentative conditional framing.
features.evidence_span: "Show me any anti-abortion argument and I'll show you..."
features.rationale: The post uses a conditional setup to advance a specific interpretation of the topic.

features.feature_value: Bald, generalized dehumanizing insult without argument.
features.rationale: A direct, generalized insult targets a political actor group with high hostility.

features.feature_value: Active-shooter fear narrative plus critique for not pushing gun reform.
features.rationale: The content centers on gun violence and explicitly references gun reform as the contested policy outcome.
